Ongoing armed conflict... An environmental disaster... Other extraordinary and temporary conditions.'

verifications.claim: As of 2025-2026, TPS designated countries include Afghanistan, Haiti, Venezuela, El Salvador, Honduras, Ukraine, and others.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1 (Mar 2026): El Salvador, Haiti, Ukraine yes; Afghanistan (expired 2025), Venezuela (terminated 2025), Honduras (expired 2025) no; R2 (Mar 2025): All listed yes
verifications.reasoning: Sources list varying countries as designated during 2025-2026 due to terminations and court stays; some match (Haiti, El Salvador, Ukraine), others expired (Afghanistan, Venezuela, Honduras), creating contradiction.
